The worst
Aug 2026 • Family
Terrible food and inattentive staff. We visited this restaurant during our three-week vacation in Vietnam, and it was by far the worst restaurant experience of the entire trip.

The food was bland, poorly presented, and in some cases simply unpleasant. The male waiters spent most of their time looking at their mobile phones instead of paying attention to the guests. We had to remind them to bring our beer, and when they finally brought water, they didn’t provide enough glasses for everyone.

We left almost half of the food untouched because it was either tasteless or simply awful.

We honestly cannot understand how this restaurant can be associated with Michelin. Our advice: save your money and stay away.

Disappointing
Oct 2025 • Friends
Disappointing experience. I do understand that tables inside are not always available on ad hoc visits, so it’s recommended to make a reservation in advance for anyone wanting to visit. Maybe it was an exceptionally busy day, but then it’s the managements responsibility to make sure that there is enough staff available to ensure a proper service or as it’s done in som countries - you just block a certain amount of tables. Some dishes were directly disapproved from the waiter because apparently they were „too dry and not worth it“ which is generally quite questionable from a restaurant which praises itself to be a people’s favourite and on the Michelin guide. The food arrived within a span of 30mins one by one and it was impossible to wait for everyone’s dish to arrive before the other one got cold or soggy. On top of that half of the dishes were basically instantly plated, while the staff was not able to bring all drinks before serving food. The ordered cocktail was tasty, but it was unconventionally made and didn’t remember at all like what was ordered. The food was partially alright, partially was the meat from some dishes still dry and/or unchewable (as even warned by the staff, though there were more meals like that than what we got told). The waiter was nice to ask if he can change or cancel the dish, but sadly after the whole overall experience my appetite was lost. I don’t blame the staff, but the management here - to make that clear
